settings.title: Keep practice gear separate but matched.
settings.text: A range setup should be lighter than the course bag while still following the same color system.

settings.title: Use only pieces that support reps.
settings.text: Practice gear works best when it helps you start faster, clean clubs, and keep the session organized.

settings.title: Make the range bag easy to reset.
settings.text: The range bag should be simple enough to repack after every session without turning into storage.

settings.title: Choose the same accent
settings.text: Carry the same accent from your course bag into the range setup.

settings.title: Add practice pieces
settings.text: Use training add-ons only when they fit your actual routine.

settings.title: Keep cleanup simple
settings.text: Towel and brush should be reachable before the bag goes back in the trunk.

settings.heading: Build a cleaner practice setup.
settings.subheading: A focused setup path for range sessions, practice days, and keeping training gear from cluttering the course bag.
